notable_absence.finding: No Prerequisites/RBAC section anywhere on this page, even though every example is a CREATE INDEX/SELECT/UPDATE combination that, per this batch's statement pages (e.g. createindex.json), would ordinarily require Basic 'Write' or Advanced 'Query Index' privileges. Array Indexing is documented purely as a syntax extension of CREATE INDEX's index-key grammar and defers all privilege documentation to the CREATE INDEX page itself rather than restating it.

cross_product_finding: Two syntax extensions are called out as Capella-specific rather than generic SQL++: the `INCLUDE MISSING` modifier on a leading array index key/on the first FLATTEN_KEYS() argument ('In Couchbase Capella, you can add the INCLUDE MISSING modifier...'), and the ability to use an arbitrary UNNEST alias regardless of the ARRAY index variable name ('In Couchbase Capella, you can use any arbitrary alias for the right side of an UNNEST...'). Neither fits an existing relation shape (not a privilege/edition/deployment/UI-mode gate, just an added syntax capability), so left as a textual finding rather than forced into a mint.
